subject: Recap: DPA routing, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alexandre Moreau <alexandre.moreau@fintrust.co>, Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@fintrust.co>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: DPA routing, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff

Alexandre / Claire — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30‑minute discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Data roles: you indicated FinTrust will be the data controller for customer transaction metadata and PII; Redwood would be the processor. If that understanding changes, please flag.

2) SCC module: you prefer the Controller→Processor SCC module (module on top of our standard DPA) rather than the Controller→Controller flow. You asked whether Redwood can sign the controller→processor module with the EU SCCs. Short answer: yes — we have a standard DPA + SCC module variant we use for customers where Redwood processes customer data.

3) SOC 2: you asked whether we have SOC 2 Type II. We maintain SOC 2 Type II and can provide a redacted summary; we are happy to share the summary and arrange an NDA'd full report if required for procurement.

4) Questionnaire: you requested we start the vendor security questionnaire. I attached a short DPA draft (redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf) and a basic SOC 2 summary. Please find the FinTrust questionnaire attached (spreadsheet) — if FinTrust prefers completing our secure form instead we can send that link.

Proposed next steps (suggested owners & timing):
- Priya (me): send the draft DPA + SCC module option and confirm scope (data types & retention) by EOD tomorrow.
- Alexandre / Claire: confirm that FinTrust will be controller and confirm any residency constraints (EU data centers) by next Tue (2026‑08‑04).
- Ben (cc'ing): will prepare the procurement/price path once legal direction is confirmed.
- Rishi (cc'ing): security will kick off the questionnaire intake and confirm what SOC 2 evidence we can provide immediately.

If that matches your view, I’ll move forward with the small edits to the DPA and route the vendor questionnaire to your security contact.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0183

Attachments: redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf (DPA draft, processor variant), soc2_summary_2025.pdf (redacted), FinTrust_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (filled template)
From: Alexandre Moreau <alexandre.moreau@fintrust.co>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@fintrust.co>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: DPA routing, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear recap. Everything looks right from our side. A couple of clarifications: 

• Controller/Processor: yes, FinTrust will be Controller for all customer transaction data. We expect Redwood to accept Processor obligations and the Controller→Processor SCC module.

• Data residency: we require EU residency for production transaction data. Is Redwood able to guarantee EU-only processing/hosting for the datasets covered by the contract? If you can confirm the region restriction or point to the residency option in the DPA, that helps procurement.

• SOC 2: a redacted summary is fine for now. Procurement may request full report under NDA but we’ll surface that later in the process.

• Questionnaire: Claire will coordinate technical answers. She can either complete the attached spreadsheet or we'll fill your hosted form — whichever gets the team through fastest.

Next: Claire, I’ll hand over to you for questionnaire preference. Priya, please send the DPA with the EU SCC module indicated and a short note on residency.

Best,
Alexandre
Head of Product Security | FinTrust
alexandre.moreau@fintrust.co

Ben / Rishi — forwarding the FinTrust recap and confirmation. Key asks from FinTrust: processor role acceptance, EU‑only residency for production datasets, redacted SOC 2 summary for procurement, and finishing the vendor questionnaire.

Ben: can you prepare a quick note on price path for dedicated EU residency (if required) and any procurement timelines we should expect?

Rishi: can you confirm the SOC 2 artifacts we can share now (we attached a short summary to the first email) and whether we can provide a residency statement that commits to EU processing for covered data? If we need Legal to sign additional residency language, flag and I’ll loop them in.

Also attaching the DPA draft again — please add comment suggestions inline if there are any deal blockers.

Thanks — Priya

Priya / Ben — quick update from security: 

1) SOC 2: we can provide the redacted SOC 2 Type II summary immediately (attached: soc2_summary_2025.pdf). For procurement requests to see the full report, we will accept an NDA and then share the full report under restricted access.

2) Residency: we have an EU‑only option for customer production datasets. Implementation path: we can pin FinTrust workloads to EU regions and enforce egress rules. We typically include a residency clause in the DPA that references the customer's chosen region; if they require contractual language to prohibit transfer outside the EU, Legal will need to review and sign off. From a technical standpoint we can commit to EU processing for the scope covered by the contract.

3) SCC module: controller→processor module is supported. Attachments include a recommended SCC module snippet that Legal can insert into the DPA (I flagged the few clauses that differ from our default processor flow).

Next actions (security):
- Rishi: send final SOC 2 redacted summary to FinTrust now and share the secure link for the full report under NDA.
- Priya: incorporate residency clause placeholder into the DPA draft and indicate the chosen EU regions.
- Alexandre / Claire: confirm whether Claire will fill the attached questionnaire or prefers our hosted form; if the spreadsheet works, Claire can return it to me and I’ll review technical answers before we return it.

I attached: soc2_summary_2025.pdf, scc_module_controller_processor_snippet.docx

— Rishi
